files.count-plate.luma:
use units
use param
use cad
use jobs

count = param.count("hole_count", 2)
blank = cad.plate("blank", units.mm(100), units.mm(60), units.mm(8))
left = cad.through_hole("left_hole", blank, units.mm(6), units.mm(-40), units.mm(0))
right = cad.through_hole("right_hole", left, units.mm(6), units.mm(40), units.mm(0))
part = match param.value(count)
2: right
3: cad.through_hole("centre_hole", right, units.mm(6), units.mm(0), units.mm(0))
*: cad.through_hole("invalid_hole", right, units.mm(0), units.mm(0), units.mm(0))
end
cad.output("solid", part)
job = jobs.submit("definition", jobs.task("part_definition"))
